title: Quality pipeline
empty: The pipeline runs when the task's agent finishes: review → build → tests → security → merge, with self-healing of failures.

settings.title: Quality pipeline
settings.enabledDesc: Every task of a Manager run goes through review, build, tests, security and merge, with self-healing of failures. Off: a task is accepted when its agent reports done.

stageDesc.Review: Automatic code review of the agent's change.
stageDesc.Build: Build and type check of the project.

mergeDesc.Off: The pipeline does not merge; merge the branch yourself.
mergeDesc.Propose: The pipeline prepares a Merge Manager proposal; you merge it.
mergeDesc.PerPolicy: The pipeline proposes and merges right away when the merge policy allows it; otherwise the proposal waits for your approval.

settings.maxAttemptsDesc: Attempts before asking you (0 = no self-healing, at most {{max}}).
settings.maxWallMinsDesc: Wall time of the whole pipeline (1 to {{max}} minutes).
settings.maxBudgetDesc: No new fix attempt starts once the task has spent this much. Empty: only the task budget applies.
settings.stopOnRepeat: Stop when a fix repeats the failure
settings.stopOnRepeatDesc: Escalate instead of retrying when a fix produces the same failure again.
settings.escalateModelDesc: From the second attempt on, use a different (stronger) model.
settings.overridesHint: A task kind is an agent role (Backend, QA, Docs…) or a task tag. The first matching kind decides the stages; other tasks use the stages above.

errors.attempts: Enter a whole number of attempts from 0 to {{maxAttempts}}
errors.wallMins: Enter a time limit from 1 to {{maxMins}} minutes
errors.budget: Enter an amount such as 2.50, or leave the field empty
errors.kindTooLong: A task kind has at most 60 characters
errors.duplicate: This task kind already has its own stages

text.mergeReady: merge proposal ready ({{recommendation}}) — approve it in the Merge Manager
text.mergeReadyManual: merge proposal ready — merge it in the Merge Manager
text.noBuildCheck: no build or type check is configured
text.moreAttempts: more attempts granted by the user
text.noChangeToAttack: the task has no agent branch — there is no change to attack
text.declined: self-healing stopped ({{reason}}); the user declined further attempts
text.noProgress: no progress: the last fix produced the same failure
text.reasonDisabled: self-healing is disabled for this project
text.reasonWallTime: the pipeline's time limit of {{mins}} min is reached
text.reasonBudget: the task's budget is spent ({{spent}} of {{limit}})
text.raiseBudget: self-healing stopped ({{reason}}); raise the budget and retry the task to continue
text.escalationFailed: self-healing stopped ({{reason}}) and the escalation could not be filed: {{error}}
text.moreTime: more self-healing time granted by the user
text.moreBudget: more self-healing budget granted by the user
text.superseded: superseded by a new attempt of the task
